finding.title: Duplicate shared dependence groups over-penalize same family pair
finding.fixture: Call CapitalFlowEngine._evidence_dependence with three preferred-horizon states direction_score=0.4: ETF and exchange_btc share group g1, stablecoin group unique; compare ETF and exchange_btc sharing both g1 and g2, stablecoin still unique. Same correlated family pair in both cases.
finding.source_predicted: One shared group: overlap=0.5, independence=0.5; two shared groups on same family pair: overlap=1.0, independence=0.0.
expected_assertions: Adding a second shared group for an already-overlapping family pair must not count a second distinct pair.
Unique overlapping family pairs determine overlap; a third independent family remains independent.
Permutation of family input order preserves overlap and independence.
